stop_rules: If recall rises while macro-AUPR, hard-negative separation or FPR violates a gate, classify the result as response amplification and do not promote.
If any identity overlap is non-zero, invalidate the run before test evaluation.
If the fresh test is read, do not adjust the method, thresholds, seeds or gates and do not reread it.
Failure of P2a keeps P1n frozen at Level 3 and routes the next study to the failed power or mechanism rather than deeper model search.
